Eszközöket kell váltanunk a bevezetéshez: Do we need to change tools?
A meglévő eszköztárból indulunk ki, akár: We start with your existing toolchain, including environments that combine several vendors and internal systems. We adapt the workflow and integrations to it. The assessment identifies which connections already exist and which need work.
Meglévő, régi termékben is el lehet indu: Can we start with an older, existing product?
Igen, ha kijelölünk egy érthető, ellenőr: Yes, with a clear task whose result can be checked. We map dependencies and business rules, adding tests that capture current behaviour first where necessary. The pilot scope follows the state of the product and its release process.
Egyéni próbához jó kiindulópont. Vállala: It is a useful starting point for an individual trial. For enterprise adoption, we choose a plan based on central access, data handling, administration and billing. API automation running from CI may be a separate cost. Required integrations depend on the existing tools and company policies.
Önállóan kiadhat az AI éles rendszerre?: Can AI deploy to production on its own?
A bevezetés részeként műveletenként rögz: We define autonomy for each action during rollout. Initially, AI works in an isolated environment, changes go into a PR, and release follows approval by the designated owner and pipeline checks. Approval rules must also be enforced technically.
Hogyan működik ez nagy, többtermékes csa: How does this work across a large team with several products?
Közös alapelvekkel és termékenkénti kieg: With shared principles and product-specific additions. The platform, repository rules and team support all need owners. Rollout happens in waves; access, training and measurement are part of onboarding every new team.
Mi lesz azokkal, akik nem szoknak rá?: What if people do not adopt it?
Megnézzük az okát: hiányzik a hozzáférés: We look at the reason: missing access, unsuitable tasks, no time to practise or unreliable results. Pair work on real tasks and short follow-up sessions help. The value needs to be clear in the person's actual work.
A prompttrükköknek túl nagy szerepet tul: Prompt tricks get more attention than they deserve. Clear tasks, accessible project context, usable tools and verification matter in day-to-day work. We practise these on the team's code and record useful agreements in project instructions.
Honnan derül ki, hogy megtérül-e?: How do we know whether it pays off?
A pilot során a teljes ráfordítást és a: The pilot measures total effort and quality. Faster coding is useful when the process also improves after accounting for review, fixes and operations. We use those results to decide whether to continue at a checkpoint agreed in advance.
